rooms.n: Female staff common room / prayer area

tour.c: You're standing at the main gate on the south side. The guard post is right here at the boundary, and the entrance foyer is straight ahead.
The entrance foyer, 19'-0" × 8'-11". It's a single-storey block with its roof at +12'-5", so the front of the building steps down to one storey here.
Reception, 20'-6" × 21'-5". Look up: this space is double height, 22'-1" to the ceiling, and the first floor wraps around the opening above you.
You're standing in the courtyard, 23'-0" × 28'-4". Look up: it is open to the sky and glazed on all sides through all three storeys, bringing daylight into the middle of the building.
The board room, 23'-6" × 18'-0", reached from the 6'-9" passage beside the reception.
The reading room, 20'-7" × 19'-4", with a 17'-0" clear height noted on the drawings.
The staff gym, 36'-0" × 19'-11", in the north-east welfare wing, next to the gaming room and shower and changing area.
Day care, 20'-3" × 14'-9", in the north-west wing next to the medical assist room and the female staff common room.
The west wing. Its floor sits one foot higher than the rest of the ground floor, at +2'-0".
First floor, +12'-5". The largest open-plan area: 52'-2" × 19'-5" for 38 people, with 12'-8" clear height.
The server room, 11'-4" × 15'-7", beside the male bath room on the north-east side.
Second floor, +23'-10". The rooftop cafeteria, 24'-1" × 53'-1", seats 70 people, with a bar counter and store rooms alongside. Parts of this roof are corrugated sheet, not slab.
The recreational area, 27'-2" × 19'-2", with the open handwash and bath rooms just to the north.
The masjid and prayer area (Block D), with an ablution space and a shoe rack in front of it.
The largest workstation area on the second floor, 48'-0" × 20'-1" for 32 people. That's the end of the tour — keep walking on your own.
